source_evidence.anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: The exact mean-square error for predictable Brownian weights. Exact assumptions and formula below.
source_evidence.statement: Let aᵢ be square-integrable real weights measurable at the left endpoints of a nondecreasing finite deterministic time grid. For Brownian motion B relative to that filtration, the compensated weighted square-increment sum is square-integrable and satisfies the exact identity below.
source_evidence.formula: Z=\sum_i a_i\big((B_{t_{i+1}}-B_{t_i})^2-\Delta t_i\big),\qquad \mathbb E Z^2=2\sum_i\mathbb E[a_i^2](\Delta t_i)^2.
assumptions: B is a real Brownian motion with the given filtration and measure; its law implies the measure is a probability measure. There are n≥0 cells with 0≤t₀≤⋯≤tₙ.
For every cell i, aᵢ is strongly measurable with respect to the filtration at tᵢ and belongs to L². Repeated times are allowed.
source_evidence.boundary: Weights need no almost-sure uniform bound. They may be dependent across cells; the required condition is left-endpoint measurability and a finite second moment.

steps.title: Factor the diagonal second moments
steps.mathematical_move: The compensated square of one increment has mean zero and second moment 2(Δt)². It is independent of every left-endpoint measurable weight. This also proves L² integrability of each weighted term.
steps.assessment: The formula and explanation implement the current proof move under the stated assumptions.

steps.title: Eliminate the off-diagonal terms
steps.mathematical_move: For i<j, the earlier weighted increment and the j-th weight are measurable at tⱼ. The j-th centered increment is independent of their product and has mean zero.
steps.assessment: The formula and explanation implement the current proof move under the stated assumptions.

steps.title: Expand the square and retain only the diagonal
steps.mathematical_move: Each product is integrable by the L² bounds. Interchange finite sums and integrals, cancel the cross terms and substitute the diagonal moments.
steps.assessment: The formula and explanation implement the current proof move under the stated assumptions.
